title: Cobblepets
body:
![Banner](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/932715aab073656671ca6546d13d8f4086c72504.png)

Cobblepets is a mod that introduces a large amount of [Cobblemon](https://modrinth.com/mod/cobblemon) into [Pets Mod](https://modrinth.com/mod/pets-mod). ## Supported Cobblemon Unfortunately, there isn't a one-click 'support every cobblemon at once' button. I have to add them individually. Thus, some cobblemon may not be available until you update. **However**, some additional cobblemon are available other than the ones listed on the versioning system. These cobblemon are: - Ditto - Mew & Mewtwo - Riolu & Lucario - Snivy, Servine & Serperior ## Versioning In this mod, the versioning is a little different - it's meant to serve two purposes at once. Instead of simply showing the current version of the mod with how many updates it's recieved, it shows the amount of cobblemon that have been added to the mod, using the [National Pokedex numbers](https://www.serebii.net/pokemon/nationalpokedex.shtml). However, we still need to represent patches and other various updates to the actual mod that don't contain more cobblemon. This is the full version numbering system: **Major | Cobblemon added | Minor** An example of this versioning system would be 1.105.3. (Version 1 of the mod, with every cobblemon up to Pokedex number #105 added, with 3 patches.) ## Credits All of the models and animations were created by the people behind Cobblemon. All of the credit goes to them for making these amazing works of art and licensing them under a license that allows other people to make cool things with! Any and all files from this mod that originated in [Cobblemon](https://modrinth.com/mod/cobblemon) (this includes **textures**, **models**, and **animations**, are licensed under the [Mozilla Public License 2.0](https://www.mozilla.org/en-US/MPL/). Any and all code from this mod that was created by me is licensed under the MIT License. The assets are located in a GitLab repository [here](https://gitlab.com/cable-mc/cobblemon-assets). If you want to use them in a project of your own, make sure to respect the license! ## Requirements This mod requires [Pets Mod](https://modrinth.com/mod/cobblemon) v0.7.8 or greater, and [Geckolib](https://modrinth.com/mod/geckolib) v5.5.1 or later. **Where is Cobblemon?** Unfortunately, Cobblemon is only available for certain versions of Minecraft - 1.21.1 at the most. Thus, I implemented the assets from Cobblemon directly into this mod.
